content.thinking: The Danyang-Kunshan Grand Bridge opened in June 2011.
The Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge, the longest bridge in the world at 164.8 km, opened in **June 2011**. It's part of the Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway in China.

content.text: The longest bridge in the world — the **Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge** in China (164.8 km / 102.4 miles) — opened in **June 2011**.
